subject: ILCE-6400 v2.00 updater transition and receiver-version boundary

observations.source: signed Windows updater embedded PE FUN_004012d0, FUN_00406900, and FUN_00406a70
observations.claim: The official host parses the DAT container, seeks to the FDAT extent, reads bytes directly from that file extent, and sends them through command 0x0040 before command 0x0100. No host-side decrypt or transcode was found.
The analyzed v2.00 receiver writes command-0x0040 payload bytes directly to /tmp_updater/Firm.dat and launches crypter.elf on command 0x0100.

observations.source: v2.00 crypter.elf FUN_0000b0c8, FUN_0000b03e, FUN_0000cabc, FUN_0000e1f0, and FUN_0000e02c
observations.claim: The v2.00 system crypter directly reads Firm.dat, forwards raw chunks into MsDecryptorModule, buffers up to 0x400 bytes, and invokes Dec_Scramble independently for every 0x10-byte block before the body loader consumes the stream.

observations.source: v2.00 crypter.elf imports and complete MsDecryptor vtable trace
observations.claim: No CBC primitive, IV consumer, or separate pre-decrypt transform appears in the executing v2.00 system module chain.

inferences.source: package transition ordering and v2.00 system-partition provenance
inferences.claim: The crypter and receiver extracted from the v2.00 target system are post-install artifacts. They cannot be assumed to be the pre-update receiver that processes the package which installs them.

inferences.source: raw generation-4 FDAT geometry compared with the v2.00 ECB-only system path
inferences.claim: The earlier report's required pre-crypter transcode was a version-conflation hypothesis, not a located implementation. The generation-4 transform must remain unresolved until the authentic pre-2.00 receiver or an equivalent transition build is examined.

unresolved.claim: The exact receiver and crypter binaries that install ILCE-6400 v2.00 have not been located.
The camera-side location of the AES-CBC remainder transform, its signature-verification range, and its trust anchor are not established.

conclusion: Static evidence now separates the v2.00 target-system updater components from the older receiver that must install them. The v2.00 crypter is an ECB-only post-install artifact and does not locate the generation-4 conversion path. No bypass, safe donor conversion, or installable alpha 6400 package has been established.
